Missing Fields

Missing fields using explicit input data. Returns a deterministic result without model calls or task execution.

Signature

missing_fields(payload, required)

Example input

{
  "payload": {
    "project": "demo"
  },
  "required": [
    "project",
    "target"
  ]
}

Example output

[
  "target"
]

Run from repository root

python scripts/solve.py missing_fields < examples/missing-fields.json

Limits

Operates only on supplied data. Inspect source for validation and assumptions; this helper cannot establish real-world correctness.
